signature_features: ChemDraw palette colours for heteroatoms or fragments: navy #004080, blue #0080C0, maroon #800000, purple #800040
light grey #E6E6E6 boxes behind products (crop 01 panel b, crop 05), behind transition-state labels (crop 05) and behind the starting-material group (crop 08)
bold sans-serif panel letters a, b, c at the top left of each panel, panels separated by grey #808080 rules
substrate fragments coloured and the colour carried into the product (blue/red in crops 02 and 07, maroon with blue or navy in crops 04 and 06)

notes.yield_placement: under the compound label in bold navy #004080 in crop 03, after the label as "4aa, 88%" in crop 04; differs between papers
notes.substrate_colors: two pairs, one per paper: blue and red in Bourissou et al. (crop 02 alkenol and aryl iodide; crop 07 the same pair), maroon and blue or navy in Maes et al. (crops 04 and 06). No pair is shared between the papers, so null.
notes.new_bond_color: crop 01 draws the new C to Nu bond red (about #DD211E); crops 02 and 07 (one paper, Bourissou et al.) draw the new C to aryl bond black and bold. The crops disagree, so null.
notes.highlight_fill: null at top level: among the reaction figures only crop 01 shows the fill (grey #E6E6E6 behind the panel b products, none in panel a) and crop 02 has none, so there is no 2+ agreement. The fill also appears in crop 05 (transition-state labels and product boxes) and crop 08 (starting-material group), which are cycle and energy figures; see the figure_types sections.
notes.arrow_length: 13.0 bond lengths in crop 01 (long multi-reagent arrow), 6.3 in crop 04 and 7.2 in crop 02; the median 7.0 is recorded
notes.abbreviate_groups: Ph removed: crop 02 draws both phenyl rings in full, while Ph is abbreviated only in scope crops 03 and 04. OMe is the ether group (crops 03, 04); crop 09 writes a methyl ester as MeO-C(=O) in an energy profile, whereas scope crop 03 writes esters as CO2Me.

substrate fragments colour-coded and the colours kept in the product

reaction_scheme.notes: highlight_fill rests on crop 01 only: grey boxes behind the two panel b products (2 and 3); panel a and crop 02 have no fill. yield_format is null because neither reaction-scheme crop (01, 02) prints a yield; the {value}% format comes from the scope crops 03 and 04 at top level.

signature_features: reaction header with conditions on the arrow above a grid of products, sections separated by grey #808080 rules (crop 03) or a dashed rule (crop 04)
section titles in bold navy #004080 (crop 03) or bold panel letters A/B (crop 04)
footnote letters in square brackets or superscript after yields
section titles on light grey #F5F5F5 tabs (crop 03)
substrate_scope.notes: variation colour differs and stays null: crop 03 draws the varied R1 and R2 groups black, with the sulfonamide nitrogens blue (scaffold atoms, not the varied part); crop 04 draws the varied amine part maroon (about #6C0000 to #800000 on the stroke).

signature_features: cycle drawn with black arcs around a circle (crops 06, 07); crop 05 is an open loop
incoming and leaving species on short curved black arrows touching the cycle arc
framed legend or catalyst box with black outline, in crop 06 with a grey drop shadow
grey #E6E6E6 tabs behind transition-state labels and product boxes (crop 05)
catalytic_cycle.notes: intermediate labels differ and stay null: Int1 to Int8 in bold (crop 05), grey bold capital letters A to D (crop 06), bold compound numbers 2 and 2v (crop 07). Catalyst colour differs and stays null: Au orange in crop 05, black in crops 06 and 07. Cycle shape differs and stays null: crop 05 is an open loop, crops 06 and 07 are circles. Step names: plain black beside the arrows in crop 07 only (crops 05 and 06 have none). Grey #E6E6E6 fill: crop 05 only (transition-state tabs and product boxes); crops 06 and 07 have no fill (crop 06 has grey drop shadows on its pathway boxes). The catalyst sits centred in a black-framed box in crop 07 only.

signature_features: thick horizontal level bars (15-17 px, about 3x the bond line) joined by thinner solid slanted lines
bold species name stacked over its energy value beside each bar, above the bar for most levels and below for some (crops 08, 09)
vertical axis arrow at left with DeltaG label in kcal mol-1
second pathway in a contrasting colour: blue #0080BF vs maroon #800000 (crop 08), grey #808080 vs black (crop 09)
energy_profile.notes: transition states carry no double dagger: crop 08 TS1minor, TS2minor, TS1major, TS2major and TS_Interconv; crop 09 TS1, TS2 and TS1'. Crop 08 reads DeltaG_sol (solvation-corrected) on the axis and crop 09 reads DeltaG298 with DeltaE in parentheses; delta_G is the nearest value. Pathway colours differ between the two crops (crop 08 blue minor and maroon major; crop 09 grey competing and black main), so pathway_colors is null.
